description: Ram Charan and Janhvi Kapoor's sports drama 'Peddi' shows a slight weekday dip after a robust opening. The film garnered ₹7.55 crore on its seventh day, bringing its India net collection to ₹187.25 crore. Overseas markets contributed an additional ₹48.80 crore gross, pushing the worldwide total to ₹271.33 crore. Telugu occupancy remains strong.
title: 'Peddi' BO day 7: Ram Charan film witnesses midweek decline

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: The Dallas Cowboys continue to be linked to Miami Dolphins linebacker Jordyn Brooks as trade speculation grows around the NFL. Brooks, coming off a first-team All-Pro season with 183 tackles, is entering the final year of his $26 million contract while Miami reshapes its roster. FOX Sports insider Greg Auman said a Dallas move feels “inevitable,” though questions remain about trade compensation and whether the Cowboys would commit to a costly long-term extension.
title: Cowboys emerge as suitors for Dolphins All-Pro in blockbuster trade buzz

title: 'Modi wants to erase Nehru's legacy': Jairam Ramesh, Sharad Pawar slam PM

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Team India is set to begin their ICC Women's T20 World Cup campaign against Pakistan with a fearless approach, according to captain Harmanpreet Kaur. Despite a mixed warm-up, the team gained confidence, particularly from Richa Ghosh's batting, as they aim for their maiden title in the 12-team tournament.
title: IND vs PAK: Harmanpreet sends 'fearless cricket' message before mega clash

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: When Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s cricket journey demanded sacrifices, Sanjeev made the toughest decision of his life and sold the ancestral land. Today, at just 15, Vaibhav is an IPL superstar, a key architect of India's Under-19 World Cup triumph and a member of the senior Indian team. The land may be gone, but it has been replaced by pride, respect and the fulfilment of a father's biggest dream.
title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi: The sacrifice behind the sensation, ancestral land a father gave

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A 21-year-old woman was allegedly assaulted by an intoxicated Delhi Police constable in Gurgaon's Sector 56. The accused also threatened her family and issued a rape threat to her younger sister. The constable was arrested and his bail application was dismissed. Police have added POCSO charges. CCTV footage is being examined.
title: Drunk Delhi cop enters Gurgaon society, assaults woman and threatens to rape her sister

author: TNN
description: A farmer's wife, Hausabai, stepped in to plough their land after lightning killed one of their bulls. The poignant images of her plight gained traction on social media, prompting swift action from chief minister Devendra Fadnavis. Officials provided the family with a new bull and financial aid, offering much-needed relief from their debt-ridden struggle.
title: Maharashtra woman ploughs field in bullock’s place; govt steps in with a bull

author: SAMAD HOQUE
description: Four Bangladeshi men were arrested in Gurgaon for a house robbery and hostage situation last week. The accused, with multiple prior criminal cases, attempted to flee during their apprehension, sustaining injuries. They had planned to escape to Bangladesh after stealing valuables worth approximately Rs 9 lakh.
title: 4 Bangladeshi men hold Gurgaon family hostage and rob them, arrested

author: RAJIV KALKOD
description: A six-year-old girl's death in Bengaluru has been solved with her mother's live-in partner confessing to hitting her in the stomach and muffling her cries after she spilled ice cream. The combined trauma led to the child's death. The accused is in police custody, while the mother remains elusive.
title: Bengaluru: Ice cream spill led to assault on 6-year-old, mother's boyfriend confesses
